basePrompt: Create ONE new square office reaction sticker based closely on the supplied reference duck. Preserve its round white body, huge round white eyes with tiny black pupils, floppy black beret, yellow-orange beak and thick dark slightly rough outline. Duck stands beside a tiny whiteboard showing only three simple colored geometric boxes connected by arrows, holds a pointer in one wing and pulls two misaligned boxes together with the other, intensely serious puzzled face.

Duck proudly holds one large bright red blank folder high above a comically teetering stack of small gray folders, round urgent eyes, free wing points decisively upward, little orange alarm bell at feet.
Duck leans forward nosily with bulging curious eyes and a magnifying glass, other wing holds a tiny clock with simple hands but no numbers, impatient yet cute exaggerated posture.
Duck anxiously presents a blank paper on a clipboard with both wings toward the viewer, enormous pleading eyes and pursed beak, a comically large approval stamp waiting beside it, tiny sweat drop.

Duck proudly pushes forward a neat closed mint-green folder carrying a large green checkmark symbol, cheeky satisfied eyes, one wing gives a triumphant thumbs-up-like feather gesture, tiny confetti pieces.

Duck hugs an absurdly tall stack of blank paperwork while raising one wing in a desperate stop gesture, tiny trembling legs, enormous haunted eyes, beret sliding sideways, very funny nonviolent office exhaustion.
